decision.explanation: The provided source documents D1S1 and D2S1 contain direct, conflicting assertions regarding the premiere date of The Walking Dead Season 11. D1S1 states the date as 'August 2, 2020', while D2S1 states it as 'August 22, 2021'. Per the instruction to treat all audits and saved answers as fallible and to preserve separately valid referents where competing assertions exist without inventing authority to resolve them, both dates are retained as valid candidates found in the source text. Other segments (D3) discuss episode 24 release dates in 2022, which are irrelevant to the season premiere.
